clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Bluff, Magatha Grimtotem sends you to seek help for Stonetalon's blighted spirits. She turns to Apothecary Zamah, the Forsaken emissary in the Pools of Vision, to bring tauren and undead knowledge together.

Magatha Grimtotem sees practical value in the Forsaken alliance. When word reaches Thunder Bluff of corrupted elemental spirits and suffering land in the Stonetalon Mountains, she turns to the undead for help. She believes those who understand disease can help cure it, so she sends you to the Royal Apothecary Society instead of seeking traditional druidic remedies.

Apothecary Zamah represents Undercity interests on Kalimdor from the Pools of Vision beneath Spirit Rise. Tauren shamans, priests, and seers use the cavern as a sacred retreat, and Zamah's presence brings Forsaken work into their midst. Magatha sends a serpent messenger ahead of you to alert Zamah, opening a direct line to the Forsaken's alchemical researchers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The tauren have a bond with the land, and it pains me to hear of Stonetalon's plight. But I fear that to heal the land, we must first remove the disease upon it.
Is it not fortunate, then, that the Forsaken are allied with us? They know much of disease. I believe they can aid us, and by doing so they will strengthen the trust between our people.
Speak with Apothecary Zamah. She is a scholar and an emissary of the Forsaken. You will find her in the Pools of Vision below the Spirit Rise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Magatha sent word of your coming, friend. Although my heart beats no longer, I still feel sorrow for the spirits of Stonetalon.
The Forsaken are eager to offer what help we can.
